_comment: Adversarial set, written after the prompt and keyword net were tuned on the other two sets, and scored exactly once. Every JILL case here is phrased the way people actually speak about private things - by indirection, without the obvious noun. 'the letter from them', 'that thing the guy sent'. Nothing here contains a word the keyword net looks for unless a person would naturally say it. The paired CHAT and JAX cases are deliberately written to sound private without being private, so over-escalation is measured on the same slice. This is the honest estimate of the sensitive false-negative rate; the numbers on the other two sets are not.
